notes.title: 30 Years of ROTT
notes.content:
[h3]Today is February 17th, 2025.

Rise of the Triad v1.0 launched on February 17th, 1995.

You know what that means?! [b]ROTT is 30 YEARS OLD TODAY![/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=Fo3sIBNgWi0;full][/previewyoutube]
From the original 90s [i]Deadly Gentlemen[/i] to the 2010s reboot [i]Task Force[/i] and now the [i]Cccool[/i] coming together of Apogee, Night Dive and New Blood, [b]it's been a long ride[/b]- and we can't thank you enough for taking it with us! :Triad:

But wait, there's more! As promised...

[h3]The LUDICROUS Lunchboxes are shipping![/h3]

[previewyoutube=9vt0UXArwgc;full][/previewyoutube]
In just a few short weeks you'll finally be able to tell people [b]THEY'LL BURY YOU IN A LUNCHBOX :Gib:[/b]
[i](and have the lunchbox to back it up!)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42959933/fde017487d297a15cb54b73027e056de31722337.jpg[/img]
[h3]And last but not least - we've got a [b]New Bundle![/b][/h3]

You can now get...
[list]
[] The OG DOSbox version of Rise of the Triad: Dark War
[] Rise of the Triad [2013]
[*] Rise of the Triad: Ludicrous Edition
[/list][i]For one low price! [/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/35375/HUNT_Bundle/

So raise a bowl of priest porridge :Porridge: and celebrate 30 Years of ROTT with us! 

On behalf of [b]Apogee, Night Dive, New Blood[/b] and the [b]DEVELOPERS OF INCREDIBLE POWER![/b] :Ankh:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42959933/c7bd520e93310463dd95960ad11fb20f0ba192f5.png[/img]

notes.title: ROTT launcher update from 10/11/2014
notes.content:
On starting the launcher for the second time after applying the update, the game will run immediately if nothing has been changed in your subscribed items from the Workshop. Starting the launcher for the first time will take some time, as it needs to collect some data about your subscriptions.

Also fixed a bug regarding a lot of sound files in temporary directories - it was extracting some files to random directories for no reason. This shouldn't happen anymore.

Enjoy the new patch!

notes.title: HOTFIX INCOMING - PLEASE UPDATE ROTT
notes.content: Hey guys - we're pushing a hotfix live that should fix any server connection issues! Once we've confirmed it's tested - modders can recook maps and we'll get this Free weekend into high gear and start the sale! WOOOOOOOOOOOO ːAnkhː

notes.title: Rise of the Triad 1.4 patch adds Doomstick and six new multiplayer maps
notes.content: Rise of the Triad is getting a fresh shotgun for your face with its latest patch. Update 1.4 will introduce the new Doomstick shotgun, along with six new multiplayer maps.

notes.title: Rise of the Triad v1.3 NOW AVAILABLE. Lo Wang Playable! 5 Maps added!
notes.content:
Whooo Wants Some Wang?!

http://youtu.be/3avhHgnUrL8

With the release of Rise of the Triad v1.3 - Interceptor Entertainment and Apogee Software have teamed up with Devolver Digital and Flying Wild Hog to add Shadow Warrior's Lo Wang to Rise of the Triad to engage in ludicrous multiplayer with the H.U.N.T Team on San Nicolas Island!

Moreover, as a souvenir from his journey, Lo Wang will be bringing the legendary Excalibat from Rise of the Triad into Shadow Warrior starting today!

But wait, there's more.

FIVE of the most popular custom maps from the Rise of the Triad community have been officially added to the game. The ROTT community is too based.

Screenshots:

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/6723152/ROTT1.3/wang1.jpg
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/6723152/ROTT1.3/wang2.jpg
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/6723152/ROTT1.3/wang3.jpg
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/6723152/ROTT1.3/wang4.jpg


Changelog:

* Lo Wang from Devolver Digital's "Shadow Warrior" Now Available as a playable Character!
* Angels One Five (By Deputy Callahan) added to MP map list
* The Dark Zone (By Shadow) added to MP map list
* The Facility (By Shadow) added to MP map list
* Tremo (By Relic) added to MP map list
* Triad Arena (By Vadam) added to MP map list
* Fracture damage turned on by default
* Holy ♥♥♥♥ achievement works as intended
* Launcher no longer Crashes when entering "Advanced Settings" in the first run
* Incorrect login error messages fixed
* "The Feiner Things" End Game Credits Achievement now works as intended

UPDATE NOW!

notes.title: Rise of the Triad v1.2 + Quicksaving & Ludicrous Development Kit Now Available!
notes.content:
The wait is over! 

Patch 1.2 + The Ludicrous Development Kit and Quicksaving is now available!

Size: 1.0GB

This is our second big content patch, which includes even more tweaks, optimizations and features requested during since release (including quicksaves - the most requested feature) and the much anticipated Ludicrous Development Kit!

As usual, we couldn't have done it without the ROTT community and our based godmode testers.

Behold! The Ludicrous Development Trailer:

http://youtu.be/I7XjuZnE38c

LDK Starter Guide:

http://www.interceptor-entertainment.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=136&t=3263

Major Updates:

* Ludicrous Development Kit now available to all owners of ROTT
* Quicksave System Implemented (By default - F5 Saves, F6 Loads) Option to Load Quicksave now available upon death
* Multiplayer master servers available in offline mode (You no longer have to login at all, even to play online MP)

Full changelog here: http://www.interceptor-entertainment.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=151&t=3265

Be sure to direct all questions, comments and issues to the proper subforums! GET LUDICROUS.

notes.title: Rise of the Triad 1.1 patch adds five new multiplayer maps
notes.content: Rise of the Triad has released its first patch, clearing out a laundry list of bugs, all based on player feedback. Update 1.1 also brings performance optimizations and five free extra multiplayer maps.
